# Financial Times

> > The Financial Times is a leading global news and financial data platform covering markets, geopolitics, economics, and business with real-time market data and premium editorial analysis.

The Financial Times provides comprehensive coverage of global markets, geopolitical developments, and economic news across major regions including Europe, Asia, Americas, and Middle East. The site offers both free editorial content and premium subscription access to market data, digital editions, and in-depth analysis.

## Key Topics

- Financial markets
- Geopolitics
- Global economy
- Ukraine war
- Middle East conflict
- Energy crisis
- Semiconductors
- Emerging markets
- Digital subscription
- Market data
- Opinion analysis
- Financial news
- US politics
- China economy
- European regulation

## Markets & Data

- [Markets data - stock market, bond, equity, commodity prices](https://markets.ft.com/data): Live market data dashboard with stock indices, bonds, currencies and commodities.

## Subscriptions & Access

- [Subscribe to the Financial Times](https://www.ft.com/products): FT subscription plans including Standard Digital, Premium Digital and newsletters.

## Global News & Analysis

- [World](https://www.ft.com/world): Global news coverage from Europe, Asia, Middle East and Americas.
- [Global Economy](https://www.ft.com/global-economy): Global economic data, central bank policy and financial market analysis.

## Geopolitics & Conflict

- [War in Ukraine](https://www.ft.com/war-in-ukraine): In-depth Ukraine-Russia conflict coverage with maps and strategic analysis.
- [Middle East war](https://www.ft.com/middle-east-war): Latest news and analysis on Middle East conflict involving Israel, Iran and US.

## Regional Coverage

- [US](https://www.ft.com/us): US news on politics, economy and international relations with analysis.
- [UK](https://www.ft.com/world-uk): UK news covering politics, economy, energy and Labour government.
- [Europe](https://www.ft.com/europe): European news on economy, politics, business and AI regulation.
- [China](https://www.ft.com/china): China news covering economy, politics, tech and US-China relations.
- [Asia-Pacific](https://www.ft.com/asia-pacific): Asia-Pacific news covering semiconductors, Hong Kong and regional business.
- [Middle East & North Africa](https://www.ft.com/middle-east-north-africa): MENA region news on economy, politics, energy and geopolitics.
- [Americas](https://www.ft.com/americas): Americas news covering economy, politics and geopolitical developments.
- [Africa](https://www.ft.com/africa): Africa news on economy, politics and business including Nigeria coverage.
- [Emerging markets](https://www.ft.com/emerging-markets): Emerging markets news with analysis on geopolitics and financial trends.
